author: barnabasbusa
content:
Nimbus pq-devnet-0 doesn't compile, so we can't build an image from your branch.

beacon_chain/validators/beacon_validators.nim imports sequtils twice:
- line 17: std/[algorithm, os, sequtils, strutils, tables, uri]
- line 46: from std/sequtils import findIt, mapIt, toSeq

Your config.nims has hintAsError DuplicateModuleImport:on, so it fails with:
beacon_validators.nim(46, 10) Error: duplicate import of 'sequtils'

Your own CI is red on the branch for the same reason (last four commits, including f20285b3c). Fix: delete line 46 and push. Then we rebuild and roll.

Also: both Nimbus nodes on the devnet are stuck at slot 863 ("Received blocks from an unviable fork", "Could not rewind further than the last finalized epoch", "Unable to continue syncing, please restart the node"). We'll wipe the db and resync once the new image is out.
